enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Large Scorpion Poison: On a critical hit, this weapon injects the target with Large Scorpion poison, causing 1 to 4 Constitution loss with an additional 1 to 4 Constitution loss after 1 minute if a DC 14 Fortitude save is failed.
Wounding 2: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 2 Constitution damage on each hit.
Critical Wounding 2: This deadly weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 2 Constitution damage on each critical hit.

Proof Against Poison +8: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).
